277567413.description:
Natural Stone Collection
Polished Agate and Amethyst Specimens - Brazil Origin
Vintage Collection, 7 Pieces
This assembly of geological specimens highlights the diverse mineralogy of South American deposits, specifically those of Brazil. Included are three distinct macrocrystalline quartz specimens (agate), each cut and polished to reveal concentric chalcedony banding and translucent crystalline centers. The collection is further enhanced by amethyst in both its raw druzy form and a polished hexagonal point, representing the purple variety of quartz colored by iron impurities. A polished pink stone egg and a small black mineral specimen complete the set.
3 Polished Agate display chunks/bookends in teal, blue, and earth tones
1 Amethyst Druzy cluster with deep purple crystalline surface
1 Polished Amethyst Obelisk point
1 Polished Pink Stone Egg specimen
1 Small Black mineral specimen (Tourmaline style)
Original "Made in Brazil" label present on blue agate specimen
Total set weight: 9.4 lbs
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. Polished surfaces maintain a high-gloss finish. Natural inclusions, internal fractures, and minor surface pitting are characteristic of geological specimens and are not considered defects. The amethyst druzy retains sharp, well-defined crystals. No significant modern damage or repairs noted.

277301439.description:
Lot of 24 Mixed Mineral Crystal Gemstone Specimens Polished Raw Stones
This lot includes 24 assorted collectible mineral and gemstone specimens. The collection features a variety of polished and raw stones such as amethyst clusters, tumbled stones including possible obsidian, jasper, rose quartz, dalmatian stone, and opalite. Also included are raw green fluorite, a selenite wand, desert rose gypsum, and other mineral specimens. The lot contains two wire-wrapped gemstone trees suitable for decorative or metaphysical uses. The stones vary in size, shape, and color, with hues ranging from deep purples and blacks to greens, whites, and browns. All items are in good, used condition, suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or crystal enthusiasts.
